Subject: Pilot Proposal: Invoice Handling Assessment

Hi Morgan,

I am writing to propose our six-week pilot to assess invoice handling. This pilot addresses your hope for a 20% shorter handling time, noting that no baseline or measured savings exists. Please note that a production rollout is excluded from this scope.

The engagement is set at a $30,000 fixed fee for the pilot. Regarding prerequisites and scheduling, security approval is required before access to client data, and no start date has been approved.

To move the discussion forward, please approve the pilot scope and the $30,000 fee, subject to security clearance.

Best regards,

Jordan  
Engagement Lead
